en-US.description:

I did it..! I got a hair transplant .. Shagaru........

It was so expensive that I look like I’ll be twiddling my thumbs for months.................

But so far, I’m super satisfied ..

I worked hard to record videos from day one through week two!

Now that I’m entering week three, I’ve lost quite a bit of hair ..^_ㅠ

I didn't get a huge amount transplanted, so I thought I’d be okay even if the so-called "dark period" came? ..

But maybe I got used to it during those two weeks... but seeing it actually fall out made me so sad .....

Still, since new hair grows in about 3-4 months, I’ll try to hang in there a little longer, hehe .. 🧑🏻‍🦲

Once the hair settles in a bit, I’ll bring you another Q&A !! 🎀

snippet.title: 크리스마스에 런던이라니••❤️🎄4박5일 영국 여행 VLOG✈️ (충격받은 영국 물가..😱 여행=싸움 국룰..? ) | 소윤Soyoon
snippet.description:
💌 contact mail : soyoon@honeybeestudio.kr 
💌https://www.instagram.com/ahsy_u/

#영국여행 #인생스콘 을 만나다.. 근데 #음식_맛없어 .. #물가에바
#영국물가 #충격

여러분 저!!!!! 범이랑 아주아주 오랜만에 !!!!!! 여행을 다녀왔는데요 헤헤헤 
브이로그도 열쒸미 담아왔어요 !!!!!!!아쥬 알차게 !!!!!!!!!! 

크리스마스에 범이가 연차를 내서 짧은 휴가(?) 가 생겼었는데,
그냥 집에서 보내기엔 아쉬워서 여행지를 찾다가 영국으로 결정했답니다! 

근데.. 너무 언럭키.. 하필 저희가 여행간 그 시점에.. 파운드가 최고를 찍었지 모에요 ^^..

그래서 돈이 공중분해가 된 기분이지만 .. 낭만적이었던 영국 마음과 눈으로 아주아주 잘 즐기다가 왔습니다 !!! 

소매치기 많다고 해서 걱정했는데, 전혀 그런 낌새도 없었구.. 그냥 다 좋았어요 ㅠㅠㅠ
(음식 빼고..)
음식은 맛 없기로 악명이 높길래 어느정도지? 했는데, 음.. 무슨 말인지 바로 알겠더라구요 ㏊㏊㏊！한국 음식 최고 ! 

말이 길어졌는데, 영상 재밌게 봐주셨으면 좋겠구 !!! 다음에 더 재밌는 영상으로 가지고 올게요 💕

en-US.title: London on Christmas Day••❤️🎄4 Nights 5 Days UK Travel VLOG✈️ (Shocked by the UK prices..😱 Is trav...
en-US.description:
💌 Contact email: soyoon@honeybeestudio.kr 
💌https://www.instagram.com/ahsy_u/

#UKTravel #EncounteringTheSconeOfMyLife... But #Food_Tastes_Bad... #Prices_Around_British_Prices #Shock

Everyone!!!!! Bum and I went on a trip together for the first time in a long time! Hehehe

I even made a vlog full of delicious food!!!!!!! It was so packed!!!!!!!!!!

Bum took his annual leave for Christmas, so we had a short vacation(?),
but it felt like a waste to just spend it at home, so we looked for a travel destination and decided on England!

But... we were so unlucky... The pound happened to be at its highest right around the time we went on our trip ^^..

So, I feel like my money went to waste... but I thoroughly enjoyed the romantic England with my heart and eyes!!!

I was worried because they said there were a lot of pickpockets, but there wasn't a hint of that at all. Everything was just great ㅠㅠㅠ
(Except for the food..)
The food is notorious for being bland, so I wondered how good it would be, but... um... I understood right away what you meant! Korean food is the best!

I've talked too much, but I hope you enjoyed the video!!! I'll be back with an even more entertaining video next time 💕
